special_situations.headline: Outcome of the Meeting of the Board of Directors held on Monday, 24 August 2026 - In-principle approval for proposed acquisition
special_situations.summary: Board gave in-principle approval to acquire a US healthcare entity plus preferential fundraise
special_situations.impact: Deal value not disclosed (terms pending); for context <cite index="50-7,50-10">Blue Cloud Softech Solutions FY26 recorded revenue from operations of ₹1,002 crore, compared with ₹796.86 crore in FY25, with profit after tax at ₹60.50 crore, up from ₹44.27 crore in FY25</cite>.
special_situations.risk: Consideration/structure undisclosed; preferential issue could dilute existing shareholders
special_situations.view_reasoning: Strong FY26 growth and profitability, but deal size and dilution impact unknown until definitive terms signed

special_situations.headline: Nyssa Corporation Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 27/08/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve its'' Stake Sale in Proprietorship Firm
special_situations.summary: Board to consider sale of stake in a proprietorship firm on 27 Aug 2026
special_situations.impact: No deal value disclosed; company is a micro-cap (~$1.37M market cap, ~$384K TTM revenue) so even a small sale could be relatively significant
special_situations.risk: Micro-cap with sparse disclosures; prior similar stake sale hurt revenue comparability
special_situations.view_reasoning: Only an intent-to-consider notice; firm already sold 99% stake in Mark Developer in Nov 2025, shrinking base.

special_situations.headline: Letter of Offer for the Rights issue
special_situations.summary: Board approved ₹59.96 crore rights issue at ₹10/share, 44:15 ratio
special_situations.impact: Highly dilutive: raise vs ~₹22.5 Cr market cap; share count nearly quadruples (2.04Cr→8.04Cr shares)
special_situations.risk: Massive dilution to tiny, low-profitability NBFC with weak governance history
special_situations.view_reasoning: Screener flags low promoter holding (10%), 41% pledge, weak ROE; raise dwarfs company's tiny scale

special_situations.headline: Clarification of CIRP order

special_situations.impact: No deal figure — insolvency proceedings remain paused, operations and FY26 dividend plan continue as normal
special_situations.risk: Unresolved legal overhang; CIRP could reactivate depending on Sept ruling
special_situations.view_reasoning: Stock near 52-week low, declining profit margins, but stay keeps status quo pending September hearing

special_situations.view_reasoning: Auditors flagged material going-concern uncertainty and a severe cash crunch from receivable delays.

special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received revised Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 24, 2026 for Lunolux Midco ....

special_situations.impact: No cash figure disclosed; sponsor has encumbered ~62.55%+ of its 62.6% promoter stake
special_situations.risk: Heavy sponsor-level share pledging despite healthy operating business
special_situations.view_reasoning: Operating business is strong (revenue/profit growing, FY30 targets set) but sponsor leverage adds overhang risk.

special_situations.headline: The Exchange has received revised Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 on August 24, 2026 for Setco Engineering Pvt Ltd
special_situations.summary: Revised promoter (Setco Engineering) share-encumbrance disclosure, ongoing pledge activity
special_situations.impact: No cash figure; promoters have pledged 71.3% of holding per latest data, against FY26 revenue ~₹730 Cr
special_situations.risk: High promoter pledge, ₹732 Cr contingent liabilities, and FY26 net loss ~₹126 Cr
special_situations.view_reasoning: Recent months show promoters releasing pledges (deleveraging), but pledge levels and losses remain elevated.

special_situations.impact: ~₹104 Cr total (₹45.48 Cr SPA for 20.21% + ₹58.5 Cr open offer for 26%) vs FY26 revenue ₹433.8 Cr (~24%)

special_situations.view_reasoning: Genuine change-of-control deal on an improving micro-cap turnaround, but re-rating may already be priced in.

special_situations.headline: Letter of Offer dated August 25, 2026 for Rights Issue of Partly- Paid up Equity Shares of Jaykay Enterprises Limited
special_situations.summary: Final Letter of Offer issued for ₹154.29 Cr rights issue of partly-paid shares
special_situations.impact: ~55% of FY26 revenue (₹154.29 Cr raise vs ₹282.3 Cr revenue); funds new defence manufacturing facility and debt repayment
special_situations.risk: Dilution; auditors flagged fund misappropriation at a subsidiary
special_situations.view_reasoning: Strong defence-order growth (162 Cr IRCON order) but a qualified audit opinion on subsidiary fraud is a governance yellow flag.

special_situations.headline: Filing of Detailed Public statement received by the Company from Acquirer Mrs Nandini Modi and Kirit Modi in connection with open offer, to acquire upto 48,75,000 fully paid up equity shares ....

special_situations.view_reasoning: Genuine change-of-control at a fair premium, but the 20% circuit-hit re-rating means much of the news is already in the price.
